text.en:
Paragraph 3 of the Rules governing Military Tribunals as promulgated by Presidential Decree
No. 39 is hereby amended to read as follows:
"3. Jurisdiction.
(a) Military Commission. All cases involving offenses where the range of punishment that may be imposed is
confinement for at least six (6) years and one (1) day, or a fine of not less than two thousand pesos
(P2,000.00) shall be referred to a Military Commission.
(b) Provost Court. The following cases shall be referred to a Provost Court:
1. Where the range of punishment for the offense charged is confinement of not more than six (6) years or a
fine of less than two thousand pesos (P2,000.00)
2. Illegal possession of firearms or explosives (violation of the laws on firearms and explosives as defined and
penalized in the Revised Administration Code, as amended, and General Orders Numbered 6 and 7, as
amended, in relation to Presidential Decree No. 9); or any offenses committed with the use of an illegally
possession firearm or explosives: Provided, however, That the range of penalty imposable for the attendant
crime or crimes is within the jurisdiction of a Provost Court as herein provided.
(c) A commissioned officer on active duty in the Armed Forces of the Philippines, shall, in all cases, however,
be tried only by a Military Commission."

All cases of illegal possession of firearms or explosives now pending before Military
Commissions, whether or not there has been arraignment, shall be tried and decided by said Military
Commission.

This decree shall take effect immediately.
DONE in the City of Manila, this 3rd day of February, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and
seventy-six.
